experiment: HPO-003 Recursive Reconfiguration of Ziran System

proposals.name: veil_coverage
proposals.rationale: operations repeatedly blinded by veils: a variable for how much of the field is veiled could anticipate blindness

proposals.name: activity_trend
proposals.rationale: picturing error stays above tolerance after revising categories: the error may come from change over time that a level picture cannot carry

proposals.name: conflict_density
proposals.rationale: frequent opposite threshold factors on shared configurations

activity_trend.criterion: picturing_error DETECTED and lower with the variable than without, on held-out seeds
